replies.body:
Last one before a break: 

When we were on Patchi it really annoyed me how you'd whine and complain as soon as we started to lose and it didn't really help at all. You transitioned from pretty arrogant, annoying and generally toxic to much less so now. Not saying you can't be toxic, but much less than before. About 8 months ago when I was on Dronken, you were way calmer and only raged once for like 1 or 2 secs over a few scrims. You actually don't deserve a lot of the hate you get. There is a side of you I seriously respect. The fact that you tried and still seem to try hard to change is amazing. Not many people can change or try to and you've come a long f**king way. You stick up for your friends, defend them and stand up for what you think is right, which earns major respect from me. The hate you get is because of people looking at the one side of you and not realizing there is a second one.
